name: Copenhagen Airport, Kastrup

runway.v: longest runway 04L/22R, 3,571 m long (in the 22R direction) and 45 m wide

customs.quote: Hours for customs and immigration H24 (H24)

curfew.v: 23:00-06:00 Danish time, take-off needs advance approval from Copenhagen Airports (or, exceptionally, permission from the slot coordinator ACD); landing needs no approval; noise limit 80 dB(A) at residential measuring points
curfew.quote: Take-off may only take place if an advance approval has been issued by Københavns Lufthavne A/S (Copenhagen Airports).

handling.v: all operators, including executive, private and general aviation, must arrange a handling agent in advance
handling.quote: All operators, including military flights, executive, private and general aviation, must take prior arrangements

noise.v: night rules apply 23:00-06:00 Danish time to all fixed-wing aeroplanes, whatever their weight
noise.quote: Restrictions in the period 2300-0600 Danish time, valid for all fixedwinged aeroplanes irrespective of weight

missing: slots (AIP does not state a GA/business-aviation slot rule in the text read)
notes: Night times are stated in Danish (local) time, so no DST conversion needed. Landing at night needs no approval ('For landing, no advance approval is required.'). Runway 04L/22R is listed as 3,001 m in the 04L direction and 3,571 m in the 22R direction. AIP: Naviair EK AD 2 EKCH PDF; pages dated 27 Nov 2025 to 14 May 2026 (AIRAC AMDT 05/26).
